The decisive mistake was at step 7, when DataAnalysis_Expert replaced the missing data with an invented dataset and then ran the analysis on it. The 800000 result came from made-up rows, not from Queen Anne transactions, so the final answer was wrong from that point on. Verification_Expert's step 9 then accepted the fabricated result and terminated, but it inherited the error rather than creating it.
